name: libwebp tools
notes: 2026-11-01: img2webp, gif2webp and cwebp for still and animated WebP with alpha.
2026-11-01: Triage: assess. Report rates it worth cataloguing.

2026-11-24: Guide skills/libwebp/SKILL.md written from examples/libwebp-lossless-animation; scope is lossless cwebp/dwebp RGBA round trip and img2webp 3-frame animation durations. gif2webp, lossy and -exact untested.

evidence.result: cwebp -lossless then dwebp -pam round-tripped three generated 64x64 RGBA PNG frames; raw RGBA SHA-256 of each decode equals its source, with alpha values 0, 128 and 255 kept. img2webp wrote a 260 B animation; webpmux -info reported 3 frames at 100/250/400 ms with animation and transparency. Repeat run byte-identical.
evidence.scope: cwebp -lossless and dwebp round-trip 3 generated RGBA PNGs pixel-identically; img2webp 3-frame animation at 100/250/400 ms; macOS arm64. No lossy, -exact or GIF.

summary: The WebP reference codec distribution includes cwebp, dwebp, gif2webp and img2webp for still and animated WebP conversion. Dedicated tools expose WebP-specific quality and animation controls.
use_when: Encode still or animated WebP with native codec tools
Convert GIF animation to WebP with gif2webp
avoid_when: Use FFmpeg for broader video conversion and muxing

assessment.rationale: Official Google source tag identifies libwebp 1.6.0, dated 2025-06-30. No newer release was found in sources read; tools cover still and animated WebP conversion.
